title: Show the current date and time
summary: Display the current date and time in a readable format. You can also show it in UTC or as a Unix timestamp.

steps.explain: Display the current date and time using the system's default locale format.
steps.expect: The current date and time, e.g., 'Mon Sep  4 10:30:00 2023'.

steps.explain: Display the current date in UTC using the ISO 8601 format.

alternatives.explain: Display the current date as a Unix timestamp (seconds since 1970).
Display the current ISO week number.

steps.explain: Display the current date using the RFC-3339 format and specify its precision.
steps.expect: The date and time in RFC-3339 format with the chosen precision.

placeholders.name: PRECISION
placeholders.description: Precision level: date, seconds, or ns
